name: captain-finance-wlt
objective: Close Captain Cash-In, wallet/earnings, COD financial model, read-only destination and payout lifecycle on one WLT-owned truth while removing stale/parallel finance presentation.
truthOwner: WLT exclusively owns authoritative financial values, ledger, Cash-In, COD financial exposure/effects, earnings/commissions, payout destination/eligibility/request, settlement and reconciliation; DSH only proxies bounded trusted operations/readbacks.

tasks.objective: Converge every reachable Captain finance presentation/read path on current WLT truth
tasks.currentProblem: Primary finance uses current wallet/COD/commissions/payout components, but WltDshCaptainBridge retains stale unavailable earnings/settlement presentation and reachability is unresolved.
tasks.requiredChange: Enumerate account-finance, support finance routes, bridge sections, imports and callers; classify each as live, alias or dead; migrate every live path to current canonical components/readbacks and remove proven obsolete code/types/copy/imports without changing unrelated actor product behavior.
tasks.targetState: Captain has one coherent finance presentation backed by WLT, with no contradictory live legacy branch or local aggregate financial truth.
tasks.action: Perform caller/route/component census; run app tests before deletion; redirect valid aliases or remove dead bridge paths; verify wallet/ledger/commission/payout empty/error/partial states and cross-Captain isolation; run cleanup/import/contract checks after final removal.
mustNotChange: Do not calculate authoritative balance/earnings/payout in frontend or DSH.
Do not create a second Captain commission/read model.
Do not expose another Captain's financial records.
Do not keep a proven dead/contradictory finance route merely for compatibility without a current caller.
acceptanceCriteria: Every reachable Captain finance entry resolves to current WLT-backed components/readback.
No live stale 'unavailable' presentation contradicts implemented current earnings/payout behavior.
Cross-Captain reads fail and error/empty/partial states never fabricate zero/completed truth.
Dead legacy routes/types/imports/copy identified by reachability proof are removed cleanly.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the focused presentation convergence while preserving the single WLT-backed path; never restore two contradictory live finance truths.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused finance-presentation/readback cleanup commit after route reachability and actor isolation proof.

tasks.objective: Close the required Captain Cash-In top-up surface through the existing WLT engine
tasks.currentProblem: WLT has server-derived captain_topup and atomic top-up capture/credit, but the diagnosis did not prove any reachable app-captain top-up entry/controller even though current Product Truth requires Captain top-up.
tasks.requiredChange: Complete exact consumer census; if a governed Captain top-up entry already exists, prove it end to end; otherwise implement the smallest app-captain/shared adapter that creates/authorizes/captures only the WLT-owned top-up session and renders canonical unknown/success readback, with no DSH financial engine.
tasks.targetState: Captain can intentionally fund the canonical WLT wallet through the approved Cash-In rail, exactly once per governed attempt, and ambiguous provider outcomes cannot double-credit or appear successful before canonical reconciliation.
tasks.action: Trace top-up OpenAPI/client/backend/migration/tests and search all Captain UI/routes; exercise create/authorize/capture, duplicate retry, invalid actor/purpose, provider failure and ambiguous result with financial simulator; implement only missing surface/adapter if required and verify ledger credit plus readback.
mustNotChange: Do not implement a second top-up/payment engine in DSH or frontend.
Do not credit from client assertion, screenshot or non-authoritative provider response.
Do not treat ambiguous provider outcome as completed or retry blindly into duplicate money movement.
Do not allow caller-selected financial purpose to override server derivation.
acceptanceCriteria: A reachable Captain top-up entry exists or is added only if the census proves it missing.
Top-up purpose/actor is server-derived and cross-actor use is rejected.
Capture and wallet credit are atomic/idempotent and exactly one ledger effect is visible.
Ambiguous provider result enters governed unknown/reconciliation behavior and retry cannot double-credit.
No parallel DSH/frontend monetary truth is introduced.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the Captain surface/adapter change while preserving WLT top-up ledger history and unknown-result evidence; never delete financial facts to simplify rollback.
tasks.commitBoundary: Keep Captain top-up surface/adapter changes separate from COD model changes and verify WLT provider behavior on the exact candidate.

tasks.objective: Prove one mutually exclusive COD financial effect per order and governed payout lifecycle
tasks.currentProblem: DSH exposes Captain COD collect/remit while current Product Truth also defines Captain-funded reserve/release/finalize semantics; without explicit model selection the same order value could acquire duplicate liability/effect. Payout and reconciliation also require same-candidate duplicate/unknown-result proof.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace order payment/COD model selection from dispatch/payment allocation into WLT reserve/collect/remit/release/finalize and payout paths; prove mutually exclusive legal models per order, remove or gate obsolete overlapping semantics, and validate ledger/audit/reconciliation plus beneficiary read-only destination boundaries.
tasks.targetState: Each applicable order produces exactly one authorized COD financial model/effect; cancellation/finalization/retry are atomic and duplicate-safe; earnings are derived; payout uses only current verified destination and server-owned eligibility; unknown external outcome remains held until reconciliation.
tasks.action: Exercise concurrent COD authorization, cancellation/release, finalization, any legacy collect/remit path, replay/idempotency and model-conflict cases; test FULL_AVAILABLE/SPECIFIED payout, unverified destination, excess amount, duplicate request and provider unknown result; reconcile ledger/audit/control-panel readback before DONE.
mustNotChange: Do not create both funded COD exposure and remittance liability for the same financial effect.
Do not accept authoritative COD/earning/payout amount from frontend/DSH where WLT must derive it.
Do not let beneficiary create/update/select payout destination master data.
Do not convert provider_result_unknown to completed without governed reconciliation.
Do not bypass finance permissions or maker-checker controls on operator actions.
acceptanceCriteria: COD model selection is explicit and mutually exclusive for the same order effect; concurrent/replayed commands cannot duplicate reserve/debit/remittance.
Cancellation releases once and finalization posts once according to the selected WLT model.
Captain earnings/commissions and wallet/ledger readback are WLT-derived and cross-Captain isolated.
Payout destination is beneficiary read-only; FULL_AVAILABLE/SPECIFIED are server-validated and duplicate-safe.
Unknown external payout/COD outcomes remain auditable/reconcilable and cannot fabricate completion.
Ledger/audit/reconciliation/control-panel readback agree after every tested legal transition and no known overlapping legacy financial path remains.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused adapters/policy only while preserving immutable ledger, payout, COD and reconciliation evidence; never delete history or reopen duplicate financial paths.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused COD/payout financial-state commit after database/provider/reconciliation evidence passes.
